# CKB Contract Flow

> Knowledge base of 94 CKB (Nervos) on-chain scripts for AI agents: where each one is deployed on mainnet and testnet (code_hash, hash_type, cell_dep), how to use it (args / cell data / witness byte layouts, the cell transitions it allows, every check it enforces with its error code), and a decoder that explains any transaction in terms of these scripts.

Built from https://github.com/gpBlockchain/ckb-contract-flow-html at commit 402b2d5c7f31bec65dc00be3913f5d91cf343830. Everything linked below is plain Markdown or JSON; the bilingual (zh/en) HTML pages for people start at https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/index.html.

## Decode a transaction

Needs Node.js ≥ 18 and access to a CKB RPC; zero dependencies; it only reads from the RPC.

```sh
curl -fsSL https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/decode-tx.js -o decode-tx.js
node decode-tx.js 0x<tx hash>               # mainnet, https://mainnet.ckb.dev/rpc
node decode-tx.js 0x<tx hash> --testnet     # testnet, https://testnet.ckb.dev/rpc
node decode-tx.js 0x<tx hash> --rpc <url>   # any CKB node
node decode-tx.js 0x<tx hash> --json        # JSON instead of Markdown
```

It lists every cell, groups them by lock / type script, names the contract behind each script with a link to its doc, prints the fields its plugin parses (amounts, args, DAO phase, …) and runs the signature-free checks: ✓ pass, ✗ fail, ○ not checked (signatures and other VM-only rules), `[code]` = the script's error code. Same code as the browser decoder https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/tx.html (source: scripts/decode-tx.js, lib/ckb.js, contracts/*/plugin.js).

Without Node: call the RPC `get_transaction`, look up each lock / type script's `code_hash` + `hash_type` in the tables below (or in https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/contracts.json), then read that contract's doc.

## Contract docs

`https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/<id>.md`, one per contract (`id` as in the tables; all linked in the last section): deployments with copy-ready `script` + `cell_dep` JSON, byte layouts, transitions (inputs → outputs), constraints with error codes, notes, example transactions and source. https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/contracts.json has every contract and deployment as JSON.

- [Force Bridge bridge lockscript](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/force_bridge_lock.md) `force_bridge_lock` — lock · token · mainnet, testnet: `1 → N` Unlock: authorised by the owner cell lock (committee multisig)
- [Godwoken challenge (challenge-lock)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/godwoken_challenge_lock.md) `godwoken_challenge_lock` — lock · layer2, Godwoken · mainnet, testnet: `1 → 0` Challenge stands / revert; `1 → 0` Cancel challenge (prove the target is valid)
- [Godwoken custodian (custodian-lock)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/godwoken_custodian_lock.md) `godwoken_custodian_lock` — lock · layer2, Godwoken · mainnet, testnet: `1 → *` Finalized: used by the rollup; `1 → 1` Not finalized: deposit block reverted, restore the deposit cell
- [Godwoken delegate-cell lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/godwoken_delegate_cell_lock.md) `godwoken_delegate_cell_lock` — lock · layer2, Godwoken · not deployed: `A` Unlock
- [Godwoken deposit request (deposit-lock)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/godwoken_deposit_lock.md) `godwoken_deposit_lock` — lock · layer2, Godwoken · mainnet, testnet: `0 → 1` Request deposit; `1 → 0` Collected by the rollup; `1 → 0` Cancel after timeout
- [Godwoken Ethereum account lock (eth-account-lock)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/godwoken_eth_account_lock.md) `godwoken_eth_account_lock` — lock · layer2, Godwoken · mainnet, testnet: `1 → 0` Verify an L2 signature when cancelling a challenge
- [Godwoken block-producer stake (stake-lock)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/godwoken_stake_lock.md) `godwoken_stake_lock` — lock · layer2, Godwoken · mainnet, testnet: `1 → 1` Reused by the rollup when producing a block; `1 → 0` Producer withdraws
- [Godwoken rollup cell (state-validator)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/godwoken_state_validator.md) `godwoken_state_validator` — type · layer2, Godwoken · mainnet, testnet: `0 → 1` Initialize rollup cell; `1 → 1` Submit L2 block (RollupSubmitBlock); `1 → 1` Enter / cancel challenge, revert
- [Godwoken withdrawal (withdrawal-lock)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/godwoken_withdrawal_lock.md) `godwoken_withdrawal_lock` — lock · layer2, Godwoken · mainnet, testnet: `1 → 1` Claim after finality (UnlockWithdrawalViaFinalize); `1 → 1` Block reverted (UnlockWithdrawalViaRevert)
- [groth16-ckb verifier](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/groth16_verifier.md) `groth16_verifier` — type · zk · testnet: `0 → 1` Create a trigger cell (no verification); `1 → *` Consume a trigger cell: verify the Groth16 proof
- [iCKB logic](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/ickb_logic.md) `ickb_logic` — type · token, defi, iCKB · mainnet: `Phase 1` Deposit CKB → deposit + receipt; `Phase 2` Receipt → iCKB (xUDT); `Burn` iCKB → withdraw a deposit
- [Input Type Proxy Lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/input_type_proxy_lock.md) `input_type_proxy_lock` — lock · proxy, ckb-proxy-locks · mainnet, testnet: `A` Unlock authorised by the owner script
- [JoyID lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/joyid.md) `joyid` — lock · identity · mainnet, testnet: no cell-flow spec yet (deployments and decoder only)
- [iCKB limit order](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/limit_order.md) `limit_order` — lock · defi, iCKB · mainnet: `Mint` Place: order + master; `Match` Match: order → order'; `Melt` Cancel: spend order + master together
- [Lock Proxy Lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/lock_proxy_lock.md) `lock_proxy_lock` — lock · proxy, ckb-proxy-locks · mainnet, testnet: `A` Unlock authorised by the owner script
- [M-NFT Class](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/mnft_class.md) `mnft_class` — type · nft · mainnet, testnet: `0 → n` Create classes (issuer 1 → 1); `n → n` Update class (e.g. when minting NFTs); `n → 0` Destroy class
- [M-NFT Issuer](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/mnft_issuer.md) `mnft_issuer` — type · nft · mainnet, testnet: `0 → 1` Create issuer; `1 → 1` Update issuer; `1 → 0` Destroy issuer
- [M-NFT NFT](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/mnft_nft.md) `mnft_nft` — type · nft · mainnet, testnet: `0 → n` Mint (class 1 → 1); `n → n` Update / transfer / claim / lock; `n → 0` Destroy
- [Multisig (legacy)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/multisig_legacy.md) `multisig_legacy` — lock · system, identity · mainnet, testnet: `1 → N` Unlock & spend a multisig cell
- [Multisig V2](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/multisig_v2.md) `multisig_v2` — lock · system, identity · mainnet, testnet: `1 → N` Unlock & spend a multisig cell
- [NervosDAO](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/nervos_dao.md) `nervos_dao` — type · system, defi · mainnet, testnet: `0 → 1` Deposit; `1 → 1` Withdraw Phase 1; `1 → 0` Withdraw Phase 2
- [NexisDAO dCKB Type Lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/nexisdao_type_lock.md) `nexisdao_type_lock` — lock · defi · mainnet: `1 → *` Unlock: the named type must appear in the tx
- [Noir owned counter](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/noir_owned_counter.md) `noir_owned_counter` — type · zk · testnet: `0 → 1` Create counter (count = 0); `1 → 1` Proof-authorized update (count + 1)
- [Noir private tally (v2)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/noir_private_tally.md) `noir_private_tally` — type · zk · testnet: `0 → 1` Create a tally (proof of the initial commitment, c_old = 0); `1 → 1` Update: add a hidden amount (incl. +0 cover update)
- [nostr_binding](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/nostr_binding.md) `nostr_binding` — undefined · identity · mainnet, testnet: no cell-flow spec yet (deployments and decoder only)
- [Nostr lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/nostr_lock.md) `nostr_lock` — lock · identity · mainnet, testnet: `A` Unlock with a Nostr key (pow_difficulty = 0); `B` PoW unlock (pow_difficulty > 0)
- [Omnilock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/omnilock.md) `omnilock` — lock · identity · mainnet, testnet: `A` Normal unlock (auth signature); `B` ACP mode (bit1, no signature); `C` Administrator mode (omni_identity)
- [Omnilock V1](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/omnilock_v1.md) `omnilock_v1` — lock · identity · mainnet, testnet: `A` Normal unlock (auth signature); `B` ACP mode (bit1, no signature); `C` Administrator mode (omni_identity)
- [Opticrum (Fiber liquidity rental) lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/opticrum_lock.md) `opticrum_lock` — lock · defi, channel · testnet: `0 → Order` Buyer posts an Order (lock not executed); `Order → 0` Buyer cancels the Order; `Order → Match` Seller opens a channel and matches; `Match → Match (seller)` Seller extracts rent; `Match → Match (buyer)` Buyer withdraws / injects; `Match → 0` Seller destroys an exhausted Match
- [Output Type Proxy Lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/output_type_proxy_lock.md) `output_type_proxy_lock` — lock · proxy, ckb-proxy-locks · mainnet, testnet: `A` Unlock authorised by the owner script
- [iCKB owned owner](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/owned_owner.md) `owned_owner` — lock · defi, iCKB · mainnet: `0 → 2` Create: withdrawal request + owner token; `2 → 0` Claim: unlock the withdrawal request with the owner
- [PW lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/pw_lock.md) `pw_lock` — lock · identity · mainnet, testnet: `A` Spend with an Ethereum signature; `B` Payment without signature (same as anyone_can_pay)
- [RGB++ lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/rgbpp_lock.md) `rgbpp_lock` — lock · btc, RGB++ · mainnet, testnet: `N → M` Isomorphic transfer (BTC tx drives the CKB tx)
- [SECP256K1/blake160](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/secp256k1_blake160.md) `secp256k1_blake160` — lock · system, identity · mainnet, testnet: `1 → N` Unlock & spend
- [Session lock (session keys)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/session_lock.md) `session_lock` — lock · identity · testnet: `owner` Owner mode: spend anything / revoke; `N → ≤1` Session spend (CKB, any payee); `recipient` Session spend (recipient-scoped, 112B / 160B); `token` Token session (128B / 160B, u128 xUDT/sUDT-like amounts)
- [SHRINCS post-quantum lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/shrincs_lock.md) `shrincs_lock` — lock · identity, quantum · testnet: `1 → N` SHRINCS signature unlock (stateful 324B / stateless 2568B)
- [Single Use Lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/single_use_lock.md) `single_use_lock` — lock · proxy, ckb-proxy-locks · mainnet, testnet: `A` Spend together with a given OutPoint
- [Quantum-resistant SPHINCS+ Lock](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/sphincs_lock.md) `sphincs_lock` — lock · identity, quantum · mainnet, testnet: `A` M-of-N SPHINCS+ (SLH-DSA, FIPS 205) multisig unlock; single key is the 1-of-1 case
- [Spore](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/spore.md) `spore` — type · nft, Spore · mainnet, testnet: `0 → 1` Mint; `1 → 1` Transfer; `1 → 0` Burn

- [standard-udt sUDT type](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/std_sudt.md) `std_sudt` — type · token · not deployed: `Σin ≥ Σout` Transfer / burn (sudt only checks format); `Σin < Σout` Mint
- [standard-udt sUDT metadata type](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/std_sudt_meta.md) `std_sudt_meta` — type · token · not deployed: `0 → Meta` Create metadata (optionally with the initial mint); `Meta → Meta` Update metadata / account mints and protocol burns; `Meta → 0` Destroy metadata (reclaim CKB)

- [Zero Lock (all-zero code hash)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/zero_lock.md) `zero_lock` — lock · system · mainnet, testnet: `0 → 1` Create: anyone can put a cell under the Zero Lock; `1 → ✗` Spend: always fails
- [zk-Lock (Groth16 proof lock)](https://retricsu.github.io/community-scripts/zk_lock.md) `zk_lock` — lock · identity, zk · testnet: `0 → 1` Lock: create a zk-Lock cell (lock does not run); `1 → N` Generic unlock (Binding::None, contracts/zk-lock): any valid proof, in any transaction; `1 → N` Transaction-bound unlock (Binding::Transaction, contracts/zk-lock-bound): pi[0] = tx_hash scalar
